newsitem.title: USA: United Tech CFO backs $4 '97 EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: United Tech CFO backs $4 '97 EPS estimate.

text.p: United Technologies Corp Chief Financial Officer Stephen Page said on Friday that he was comfortable with earnings per share estimates of $4.00 for 1997.
Speaking at a Smith Barney multi-industry conference in New York City, he said "We're very comfortable with $4.00 for 1997," which is the consensus estimate of analysts according to First Call.
For 1996, United Technologies reported earnings of $3.45 per share on revenues of $23.5 billion.
Page said the company expected 1997 revenue growth of between six percent and seven percent, but added that these gains could be offset by foreign exchange costs of about $400 million dollars.
The company has about 55 percent of its business outside of the United States.

Page said the company would have about $1 billion of available cash flow in 1997, of which more than half would be used for acquisitions. "We expect acquisitions to be north of half a billion," he said.
In addition to acquisitions, Page said cash would be used for share repurchases.
